title: 10 — Press / Editorial
description: A full-page magazine editorial layout. Small "As Featured In" tag at the top, a horizontal row of grayscale press-style mastheads, a large italic serif pull-quote with attribution in the center, and a premium product shot in the lower third. Generous white space. Linen or off-white background. Reads like a back-page ad in Vogue, Kinfolk, or a high-end editorial.
